title: CIP Safety: Minor Refactoring, Part 1
description:
- Extract Method for multiple message encodings to simplify things for future bug fixes and to reduce copy-paste.
  - dissect_base_format_time_correction_message
  - dissect_extended_format_time_correction_message
  - dissect_base_format_time_stamp_section
  - dissect_base_format_time_coordination_message
  - dissect_extended_format_time_coordination_message
- Update naming/comments to match wording in the specification (to make things easier to find)
- Note: There are no functionality changes
